Set up your practice.

Choose the notes you want to hear and how they resolve. No distractions once you start.

⚙

Practice settings

Your choices are locked in for each session.

Major scale: Do, Re, Mi, Fa, Sol, La, Ti.

Only selected notes can be questions. Resolutions may use any of the 12 notes, including unselected ones.

When the key changes, a new reference cadence plays before the question.
The resolution follows scale steps toward the nearest Do; chromatic/custom uses semitones.

One phrase per chromatic degree. Separate notes with a hyphen (-), for example Sol-La-Ti-Do. The target is added at the start if omitted. Optional suffixes: + after a note to move upward, v to move downward (e.g. Do+-Re, Solv-Fa).

Blank fields use the built-in phrase for the selected scale. All 12 degrees can be edited, even if not selected for questions.

SF2 works locally in your browser; SF3 (Ogg Vorbis) playback depends on browser decoding support. No file is uploaded.

No SoundFont loaded.

Each session starts with I–IV–V–I to establish the tonic. Minor keys use i–iv–V–i.

Ready when you are.A reference cadence establishes the key; each question automatically plays only its target note.

♫ Every setting is stored in this page while it is open. Built-in piano works offline; user SoundFonts stay on your device and are never uploaded.
